name: AU Hawk
summary: The AU Hawk (owner 2026-10-18): a bubbly caricature of the 1998-2002 Ford AU Falcon, the burnout and doughnut king (tuning is part 2 of br-bwju.12; the profile is the Hawk Dash's for now). What tells it apart: a lamp pod on each front guard carrying a big round headlamp and a smaller round lamp inboard of it, a wide shallow black grille with chrome slats, white bumper-end indicators, a long flat bonnet with a soft dome, a tall upright glasshouse, a short high boot with a small body-colour lip spoiler, wide wrap-around tail lamps joined by a chrome bar, body-colour mirrors, five-spoke silver rims and no livery at all. LOD0 2612 triangles (qualified budget 3000), LOD1 876, LOD2 574. Code-built from generated reference sheets (R81). Recognition by a small vision model is NOT met: see docs/evidence/P1-V-au-hawk/recognition.md.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: The reference sheets were generated with Muse Image from a written brief (art/vehicles/au-hawk/refs/prompts/, the Hawk Dash's sheet as the layout example; art/ui/frames/ledger.jsonl). Per view: the reference crop, the model shaded, and the silhouette diff (green is model only, red is reference only). Scored by tools/vehicles/fit (Spike J's method: perspective camera, the same mask pipeline on both sides, the contact-shadow band left out).

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front detached; door_FL detached; back detached; wheel_FL detached; both front doors and the back detached; a stripped shell. Posed in a three.js viewer about each part's hinge line (tools/vehicles/evidence).

paints.pattern: Seat colour on the paint key (white texels tint: body, pods, bumpers, mirrors, lip spoiler; the glass, lamps, grille, rims and tyres keep their colour), the number on the roof (anchor roof_number) and in the HUD badge. paints-strip.png shows white plus five player colours. No livery: the AU has none.

recognition (recognition.md): the unprompted vision model names it an Australian sedan (a Commodore) in 13 of 25 renders and an AU Falcon in 0 of 25. The control (Hawk Dash) passes. Open for the owner; see recognition.md for what was tried and the options
the body is flat-sided at LOD0: the sheet's rounded flanks are approximated by the shoulder roll-in (the sheet's body is bubbly, the model's doors are slabs)
LOD2 drops the pods' second lamp, the grille slats, the indicators and the chrome bar to fit 600; the grille reads as a dark block
the engine sound profile (assets/audio/engine/au-hawk.json) is part 2 of br-bwju.12 (generated on eris, R89); until then the host falls back to the default voice
